title: Welcome New Customer
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, welcome to {store_name}! We're delighted to have you. Browse our catalogue and use code WELCOME10 for 10% off your first order. Happy shopping!
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} में आपका स्वागत है! हमें खुशी है कि आप हमारे साथ जुड़े। पहले ऑर्डर पर 10% छूट के लिए WELCOME10 कोड लागू करें।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, {store_name} mein aapka swagat hai! Pehle order par 10% off ke liye WELCOME10 code use karein. Koi help chahiye toh bataiye.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, {store_name}-এ আপনাকে স্বাগতম! প্রথম অর্ডারে ১০% ছাড় পেতে WELCOME10 কোড ব্যবহার করুন।

title: Returning Customer Welcome
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, welcome back to {store_name}! We've added new products since your last visit. Your wishlist is saved and ready for checkout.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} में वापसी पर स्वागत है! पिछली बार के बाद हमने कई नए प्रोडक्ट जोड़े हैं। आपकी विशलिस्ट सेव है।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, wapas swagat hai! Naye products add hue hain. Aapki wishlist save hai, checkout kar sakte ho.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, {store_name}-এ ফিরে আসায় স্বাগতম! আপনার উইশলিস্ট সেভ করা আছে।

title: First-Time Buyer Welcome
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for choosing {store_name} for your first order! We'll make sure your experience is smooth. Track your order anytime from your account dashboard.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, पहला ऑर्डर {store_name} से चुनने के लिए धन्यवाद! ऑर्डर की ट्रैकिंग आप अपने अकाउंट से कभी भी कर सकते हैं।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, pehla order ke liye dhanyawad! Tracking aap apne account dashboard se kabhi bhi kar sakte ho.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, প্রথম অর্ডারের জন্য ধন্যবাদ! অর্ডার ট্র্যাকিং আপনার অ্যাকাউন্ট থেকে করতে পারবেন।

title: Vendor Partner Welcome
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, welcome to the {store_name} vendor family! Your dashboard is ready. Add your first product to start selling across India. Our team is one message away for any help.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, {store_name} वेंडर परिवार में आपका स्वागत है! आपका डैशबोर्ड तैयार है। पहला प्रोडक्ट जोड़कर भारत भर में बिक्री शुरू करें।
content_hng: Hi {vendor_name}, vendor parivar mein swagat hai! Dashboard ready hai. Pehla product add karo aur selling start karo.
content_bn: নমস্কার {vendor_name}, {store_name} ভেন্ডর পরিবারে স্বাগতম! আপনার ড্যাশবোর্ড প্রস্তুত।

title: App Download Welcome
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for downloading the {store_name} app! Use code APP15 for 15% off your first in-app order. Enjoy a faster shopping experience!
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} ऐप डाउनलोड करने के लिए धन्यवाद! ऐप में पहले ऑर्डर पर 15% छूट के लिए APP15 कोड लागू करें।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, app ke liye dhanyawad! Pehle in-app order par 15% off ke liye APP15 use karein.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, অ্যাপ ডাউনলোডের জন্য ধন্যবাদ! APP15 কোড দিয়ে ১৫% ছাড় পান।

title: WhatsApp Opt-in Welcome
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for opting into WhatsApp updates from {store_name}! You'll now receive order confirmations, offers, and delivery alerts here. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} से WhatsApp अपडेट के लिए धन्यवाद! अब ऑर्डर, ऑफर और डिलीवरी अलर्ट यहीं मिलेंगे। अनसब्सक्राइब करने के लिए STOP लिखें।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, WhatsApp updates ke liye dhanyawad! Order, offer aur delivery alerts yahin milenge. Unsubscribe karne ke liye STOP type karein.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, WhatsApp আপডেটের জন্য ধন্যবাদ! STOP লিখে আনসাবস্ক্রাইব করুন।

title: First Reply - General
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for reaching out to {store_name}. I've received your message and will get back with a complete answer within {response_time}. Your ticket reference is #{ticket_id}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} तक पहुँचने के लिए धन्यवाद। आपका संदेश मिल गया है, मैं {response_time} में पूरा उत्तर दूँगा। टिकट संख्या #{ticket_id}।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, message mil gaya hai. {response_time} mein poora jawab dunga. Ticket number #{ticket_id}.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, আপনার বার্তা পেয়েছি। টিকিট নম্বর #{ticket_id}।

title: First Reply - Order Query
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, I see you've asked about order #{order_id}. Let me pull up the details and revert in a few minutes. Your patience is appreciated.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} के बारे में आपने पूछा है। मैं विवरण देखकर कुछ ही मिनटों में जवाब दूँगा।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, order #{order_id} ke baare mein poocha hai. Details check karke few minutes mein reply dunga.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, অর্ডার #{order_id} সম্পর্কে বিস্তারিত জানিয়ে কয়েক মিনিটে উত্তর দিচ্ছি।

title: First Reply - Product Query
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for asking about {product_name}. I'll share the complete details including pricing, availability, and shipping within {response_time}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {product_name} के बारे में पूछने के लिए धन्यवाद। मैं कीमत, उपलब्धता और शिपिंग के साथ {response_time} में जवाब दूँगा।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, {product_name} ke liye dhanyawad. Price, stock aur shipping ke saath {response_time} mein reply dunga.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, {product_name} সম্পর্কে মূল্য, স্টক ও শিপিং সহ উত্তর দিচ্ছি।

title: First Reply - Complaint
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, I'm sorry to hear about the issue you've raised. I take this seriously and will personally look into it. You'll hear from me within {response_time} with a clear next step.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, आपकी समस्या सुनकर दुख हुआ। मैं इसे गंभीरता से लेता हूँ और {response_time} में समाधान के साथ जवाब दूँगा।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, sun ke dukh hua. Main personally isko dekhunga aur {response_time} mein solution ke saath reply dunga.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, আপনার সমস্যা শুনে আমি {response_time}-এ সমাধান সহ উত্তর দিচ্ছি।

title: First Reply - Technical
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for the technical query. I've logged this as ticket #{ticket_id} and our team is investigating. We'll share an update in {response_time}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, तकनीकी सवाल के लिए धन्यवाद। टिकट #{ticket_id} बनाया गया है, हमारी टीम जाँच कर रही है। {response_time} में अपडेट मिलेगा।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, technical query ke liye dhanyawad. Ticket #{ticket_id} ban gaya hai, {response_time} mein update milega.

title: First Reply - VIP Customer
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for reaching out. As a valued {store_name} customer, your query is now priority #1. I'll personally make sure you get a complete answer in {response_time}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} के मूल्यवान ग्राहक के रूप में आपकी सवाल को प्राथमिकता दी जा रही है। {response_time} में पूरा जवाब मिलेगा।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, valued customer ho, isliye priority mil gayi hai. {response_time} mein poora jawab dunga.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, ভিআইপি কাস্টমার হিসেবে আপনার প্রশ্ন অগ্রাধিকার পাচ্ছে।

title: Away - Business Hours
content_en: Hi! {store_name} support is currently away. Our working hours are {working_hours}. We'll respond to your message as soon as we're back. For urgent issues, WhatsApp us at {whatsapp_number}.
content_hi: नमस्ते! {store_name} सपोर्ट अभी उपलब्ध नहीं है। कार्य समय: {working_hours}। हम वापस आते ही जवाब देंगे। जरूरी मामलों के लिए WhatsApp: {whatsapp_number}।
content_hng: Hi! {store_name} support abhi nahi hai. Working hours: {working_hours}. Wapas aate hi reply karenge. Urgent ke liye WhatsApp: {whatsapp_number}.
content_bn: নমস্কার! {store_name} সাপোর্ট এখন অনুপস্থিত। কার্য সময়: {working_hours}। জরুরির জন্য WhatsApp: {whatsapp_number}।

title: Away - Weekend
content_en: Hi! We're closed for the weekend but will reply to all messages on Monday morning. For urgent orders, use self-service in the app. Thanks for your patience!
content_hi: नमस्ते! सप्ताहांत के लिए बंद हैं, सोमवार सुबह सभी संदेशों के जवाब देंगे। जरूरी ऑर्डर के लिए ऐप का सेल्फ-सर्विस इस्तेमाल करें।
content_hng: Hi! Weekend ke liye band hain, Monday subah sab messages ka reply karenge. Urgent ke liye app self-service use karein.
content_bn: নমস্কার! উইকেন্ডের জন্য বন্ধ, সোমবার সকালে উত্তর দেব।

title: Away - Holiday
content_en: Hi! {store_name} is closed today for {holiday_name}. We'll be back on {reopen_date}. Wishing you and your family a wonderful day!
content_hi: नमस्ते! {store_name} आज {holiday_name} के लिए बंद है। हम {reopen_date} को वापस आएँगे। आपको और परिवार को शुभकामनाएँ!
content_hng: Hi! {store_name} aaj {holiday_name} ke liye band hai. {reopen_date} ko wapas aayenge. Aapko aur parivar ko shubhkamna!

title: Away - Lunch Break
content_en: Hi! Our team is on a quick break and will be back at {return_time}. For urgent order updates, please check the app or your email. Thanks!
content_hi: नमस्ते! हमारी टीम थोड़ी देर के लिए ब्रेक पर है, {return_time} पर वापस आएगी। जरूरी ऑर्डर अपडेट के लिए ऐप देखें।
content_hng: Hi! Team break pe hai, {return_time} pe wapas aayegi. Urgent order ke liye app check karein.

title: Away - Night
content_en: Hi! Our support team is offline for the night. We'll respond to your message tomorrow morning at {return_time}. For urgent issues, drop a WhatsApp message at {whatsapp_number}.
content_hi: नमस्ते! सपोर्ट टीम रात के लिए ऑफलाइन है। कल सुबह {return_time} पर जवाब देंगे। जरूरी मामलों के लिए WhatsApp: {whatsapp_number}।
content_hng: Hi! Support raat ke liye offline hai. Kal subah {return_time} pe reply karenge. WhatsApp: {whatsapp_number}.
content_bn: নমস্কার! রাতের জন্য সাপোর্ট অফলাইন। সকালে {return_time}-এ উত্তর দেব।

title: Thanks for Purchase
content_en: Thank you, {customer_name}, for shopping with {store_name}! Your order #{order_id} is confirmed. We hope you love your purchase. Tag us on socials at @{social_handle}!
content_hi: धन्यवाद {customer_name}, {store_name} से खरीदने के लिए! ऑर्डर #{order_id} कन्फर्म हो गया है। सोशल मीडिया पर हमें @{social_handle} टैग करें!
content_hng: Dhanyawad {customer_name}, shopping ke liye! Order #{order_id} confirm ho gaya. Social media pe @{social_handle} tag karein!
content_bn: ধন্যবাদ {customer_name}, অর্ডার #{order_id} কনফার্ম। সোশ্যালে @{social_handle} ট্যাগ করুন!

title: Thanks for Review
content_en: Thank you for taking the time to leave a review, {customer_name}! Your feedback helps us improve and helps other shoppers decide. We look forward to serving you again.
content_hi: समय निकालकर समीक्षा देने के लिए धन्यवाद, {customer_name}! आपकी फीडबैक हमें सुधारने में मदद करती है।
content_hng: Review dene ke liye dhanyawad, {customer_name}! Aapki feedback humein improve karne mein madad karti hai.

title: Thanks for Referral
content_en: Thank you for referring {friend_name} to {store_name}! You've earned {referral_reward} in your wallet. Keep spreading the word — every successful referral earns more.
content_hi: {friend_name} को {store_name} रेफर करने के लिए धन्यवाद! आपके वॉलेट में {referral_reward} जमा हो गए हैं। और रेफर करते रहें!
content_hng: {friend_name} ko refer karne ke liye dhanyawad! Wallet mein {referral_reward} add ho gaye. Refer karte raho!
content_bn: {friend_name}-কে রেফার করার জন্য ধন্যবাদ! ওয়ালেটে {referral_reward} যোগ হয়েছে।

title: Thanks for Feedback
content_en: Thanks for sharing your feedback, {customer_name}. We read every single message and use it to improve. Expect to see your suggestions reflected in upcoming updates.
content_hi: अपनी फीडबैक साझा करने के लिए धन्यवाद, {customer_name}। हम हर संदेश पढ़ते हैं और सुधार के लिए उपयोग करते हैं।
content_hng: Feedback share karne ke liye dhanyawad, {customer_name}. Hum har message padhte hain aur improve karte hain.

title: Thanks for Patience
content_en: Thank you for your patience, {customer_name}. We know waiting isn't fun, and we appreciate you sticking with us. Your issue has now been resolved — please confirm if all looks good.
content_hi: धैर्य रखने के लिए धन्यवाद, {customer_name}। आपकी समस्या अब हल हो गई है — कृपया कन्फर्म करें कि सब कुछ ठीक है।
content_hng: Patience ke liye dhanyawad, {customer_name}. Aapki problem ab solve ho gayi — confirm karein ki sab theek hai.
content_bn: ধৈর্যের জন্য ধন্যবাদ, {customer_name}। সমস্যা সমাধান হয়েছে — কনফার্ম করুন।

title: Diwali Greeting
content_en: Happy Diwali from the {store_name} family! May this festival of lights bring prosperity, joy, and endless orders to your business. Use code FESTIVE25 for 25% off site-wide.
content_hi: {store_name} परिवार की ओर से दीपावली की शुभकामनाएँ! उपहार कोड FESTIVE25 से साइट भर में 25% छूट पाएँ।
content_hng: {store_name} parivar ki taraf se Diwali ki shubhkamna! FESTIVE25 code se 25% off pao.
content_bn: {store_name} পরিবারের তরফ থেকে দীপাবলির শুভেচ্ছা! FESTIVE25 কোডে ২৫% ছাড়।

title: New Year Greeting
content_en: Happy New Year, {customer_name}! Wishing you and your loved ones a fantastic year ahead. As a thank-you, here's a special 20% off code: NEWYEAR20, valid for the first week of January.
content_hi: नया साल मुबारक, {customer_name}! विशेष 20% छूट कोड: NEWYEAR20, जनवरी के पहले सप्ताह तक वैध।
content_hng: Naya saal mubarak, {customer_name}! 20% off code: NEWYEAR20, January ke pehle week tak valid.

title: Eid Greeting
content_en: Eid Mubarak from {store_name}! May this special day bring joy and togetherness to you and your family. Celebrate with our festive collection and special offers.
content_hi: {store_name} की ओर से ईद मुबारक! इस खास दिन पर आपको और परिवार को खुशियाँ मिलें। हमारे फेस्टिव कलेक्शन के साथ जश्न मनाएँ।
content_hng: {store_name} ki taraf se Eid Mubarak! Festive collection ke saath jashn manayein.
content_bn: {store_name}-এর তরফ থেকে ঈদ মুবারক! ফেস্টিভ কালেকশন দেখুন।

title: Christmas Greeting
content_en: Merry Christmas from {store_name}! May your home be filled with warmth and joy. Our Christmas sale is live — enjoy up to 40% off on selected categories.
content_hi: {store_name} की ओर से क्रिसमस की शुभकामनाएँ! क्रिसमस सेल लाइव है — चुने हुए कैटेगरी पर 40% तक छूट।
content_hng: {store_name} ki taraf se Christmas ki shubhkamna! Christmas sale live hai — 40% tak off.
content_bn: {store_name}-এর তরফ থেকে বড়দিনের শুভেচ্ছা! ৪০% পর্যন্ত ছাড়।

title: Order Confirmed
content_en: Great news, {customer_name}! Your order #{order_id} for ₹{amount} is confirmed. We're getting it ready and will share tracking details shortly. Expected delivery: {delivery_date}.
content_hi: बढ़िया खबर, {customer_name}! ऑर्डर #{order_id} (₹{amount}) कन्फर्म हो गया। ट्रैकिंग जल्दी शेयर करेंगे। अनुमानित डिलीवरी: {delivery_date}।
content_hng: Badhiya khabar, {customer_name}! Order #{order_id} (₹{amount}) confirm ho gaya. Tracking jaldi share karenge. Delivery: {delivery_date}.

title: COD Order Confirmed
content_en: Your Cash on Delivery order #{order_id} is confirmed, {customer_name}. Please keep ₹{amount} ready for the delivery agent. We'll reach out before delivery to confirm.
content_hi: आपका COD ऑर्डर #{order_id} कन्फर्म हो गया, {customer_name}। डिलीवरी एजेंट के लिए ₹{amount} तैयार रखें। हम डिलीवरी से पहले कन्फर्म करेंगे।
content_hng: COD order #{order_id} confirm ho gaya, {customer_name}. ₹{amount} ready rakhein. Delivery se pehle confirm karenge.
content_bn: আপনার COD অর্ডার #{order_id} কনফার্ম। ₹{amount} প্রস্তুত রাখুন।

title: Prepaid Order Confirmed
content_en: Your prepaid order #{order_id} is confirmed, {customer_name}. Payment of ₹{amount} received successfully. We'll dispatch your order within {dispatch_time}.
content_hi: प्रीपेड ऑर्डर #{order_id} कन्फर्म, {customer_name}। ₹{amount} पेमेंट मिल गई। ऑर्डर {dispatch_time} में डिस्पैच करेंगे।
content_hng: Prepaid order #{order_id} confirm, {customer_name}. ₹{amount} payment mil gaya. {dispatch_time} mein dispatch karenge.

title: Multi-item Order Confirmation
content_en: Your order #{order_id} with {item_count} items (₹{amount}) is confirmed, {customer_name}. Some items may arrive in separate packages — we'll share tracking for each.
content_hi: ऑर्डर #{order_id} में {item_count} आइटम (₹{amount}) कन्फर्म, {customer_name}। कुछ आइटम अलग-अलग पैकेज में आ सकते हैं — हम हर एक की ट्रैकिंग शेयर करेंगे।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} mein {item_count} items (₹{amount}) confirm. Kuch items alag package mein aa sakte hain — har ek ki tracking share karenge.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} এ {item_count} আইটেম কনফার্ম। আলাদা প্যাকেজে আসতে পারে।

title: Bulk Order Confirmation
content_en: Your bulk order #{order_id} ({item_count} units, ₹{amount}) is confirmed. Our team is preparing it for dispatch and you'll receive tracking in {dispatch_time}.
content_hi: आपका बल्क ऑर्डर #{order_id} ({item_count} यूनिट, ₹{amount}) कन्फर्म हो गया। टीम तैयारी कर रही है, {dispatch_time} में ट्रैकिंग मिलेगी।
content_hng: Bulk order #{order_id} ({item_count} units, ₹{amount}) confirm. Team tayari kar rahi hai, {dispatch_time} mein tracking milega.
content_bn: বাল্ক অর্ডার #{order_id} কনফার্ম। টিম প্রস্তুত করছে।

title: Digital Order Confirmation
content_en: Your digital order #{order_id} is confirmed, {customer_name}. Download links have been sent to your email {email}. The links are valid for 1 year.
content_hi: डिजिटल ऑर्डर #{order_id} कन्फर्म, {customer_name}। डाउनलोड लिंक आपके ईमेल {email} पर भेज दिए गए हैं। लिंक 1 साल तक वैध हैं।
content_hng: Digital order #{order_id} confirm. Download links email {email} pe bhej diye hain. 1 saal tak valid.
content_bn: ডিজিটাল অর্ডার #{order_id} কনফার্ম। ডাউনলোড লিংক ইমেলে পাঠানো হয়েছে।

title: Order Status - Processing
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} is currently being processed and packed with care. We'll dispatch it soon and share tracking details within {time_estimate}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} प्रोसेस और पैक हो रहा है। जल्दी डिस्पैच करेंगे, {time_estimate} में ट्रैकिंग शेयर करेंगे।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, order #{order_id} process ho raha hai. Jaldi dispatch karenge, {time_estimate} mein tracking share karenge.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, অর্ডার #{order_id} প্রসেস হচ্ছে। শীঘ্র ট্র্যাকিং পাঠাব।

title: Order Status - Shipped
content_en: Good news, {customer_name}! Your order #{order_id} has been shipped via {courier_name}. Track it here: {tracking_link}. Expected delivery: {delivery_date}.
content_hi: अच्छी खबर, {customer_name}! ऑर्डर #{order_id} {courier_name} से शिप हो गया। ट्रैकिंग: {tracking_link}। अनुमानित डिलीवरी: {delivery_date}।
content_hng: Achhi khabar, {customer_name}! Order #{order_id} {courier_name} se ship ho gaya. Tracking: {tracking_link}. Delivery: {delivery_date}.
content_bn: ভাল খবর, {customer_name}! অর্ডার #{order_id} শিপ হয়েছে। ট্র্যাকিং: {tracking_link}।

title: Order Status - Out for Delivery
content_en: Your order #{order_id} is out for delivery, {customer_name}! The delivery agent {agent_name} will reach you by {delivery_time}. Phone: {agent_phone}.
content_hi: ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवरी के लिए निकल गया, {customer_name}! एजेंट {agent_name} {delivery_time} तक आप तक पहुँगा। फोन: {agent_phone}।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} delivery ke liye nikal gaya! Agent {agent_name} {delivery_time} tak pahunchega. Phone: {agent_phone}.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} ডেলিভারির জন্য বেরিয়েছে! এজেন্ট {delivery_time}-এ পৌঁছাবে।

title: Order Status - Delivered
content_en: Your order #{order_id} has been delivered, {customer_name}. We hope you love it! If anything isn't right, please let us know within 48 hours. Would you mind leaving a quick review?
content_hi: ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवर हो गया, {customer_name}। उम्मीद है पसंद आएगा! अगर कोई समस्या हो तो 48 घंटे में बताएँ। थोड़ी सी समीक्षा देंगे?
content_hng: Order #{order_id} deliver ho gaya, {customer_name}. Koi problem ho toh 48 ghante mein bataiye. Review denge?
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} ডেলিভার হয়েছে। সমস্যা হলে ৪৮ ঘণ্টায় জানান।

title: Order Status - Cancelled
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} has been cancelled as per your request. Refund of ₹{amount} (if applicable) will be processed to your original payment method in {refund_days} business days.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} आपकी विनती पर कैंसिल हो गया। रिफंड ₹{amount} (यदि लागू हो) {refund_days} दिनों में मूल पेमेंट मेथड में मिलेगा।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, order #{order_id} cancel ho gaya. Refund ₹{amount} (if applicable) {refund_days} din mein original payment mein milega.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, অর্ডার #{order_id} বাতিল হয়েছে। রিফান্ড {refund_days} দিনে আসবে।

title: Order Status - On Hold
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} is on hold pending verification. Please check your email for the next steps or reply here with the required info so we can proceed.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} वेरिफिकेशन के लिए रुका हुआ है। ईमेल देखें या जवाब में ज़रूरी जानकारी दें ताकि आगे बढ़ सकें।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} verification ke liye ruka hai. Email dekhein ya reply mein info dein.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} ভেরিফিকেশনের জন্য আটকে আছে। ইমেল দেখুন।

title: Tracking Link Shared
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, here's the tracking link for order #{order_id}: {tracking_link}. You can also track it from your account dashboard. Expected delivery: {delivery_date}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} की ट्रैकिंग लिंक: {tracking_link}। अकाउंट डैशबोर्ड से भी देख सकते हैं। डिलीवरी: {delivery_date}।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, order #{order_id} ki tracking: {tracking_link}. Dashboard se bhi dekho. Delivery: {delivery_date}.

title: Multi-package Tracking
content_en:
Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} has been split into {package_count} packages for faster delivery. Each has its own tracking:
{tracking_list}
content_hi:
नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} को तेज़ डिलीवरी के लिए {package_count} पैकेज में बाँटा गया है। हर एक की अपनी ट्रैकिंग है:
{tracking_list}
content_hng:
Order #{order_id} ko {package_count} packages mein baanta gaya hai. Har ek ki tracking:
{tracking_list}

title: Dispatch Delay Notice
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, due to high order volume, dispatch of order #{order_id} is delayed by {delay_hours} hours. New dispatch expected by {new_dispatch_time}. We apologize for the inconvenience.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ज़्यादा ऑर्डर वॉल्यूम के कारण ऑर्डर #{order_id} का डिस्पैच {delay_hours} घंटे देरी से होगा। नया डिस्पैच: {new_dispatch_time}। क्षमा चाहते हैं।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} ka dispatch {delay_hours} ghante late hoga. Naya dispatch: {new_dispatch_time}. Sorry!
content_bn: বেশি অর্ডারের কারণে ডিসপ্যাচ {delay_hours} ঘণ্টা দেরি হবে।

title: Courier Handoff Confirmed
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, order #{order_id} has been handed over to {courier_name}. They'll update tracking within a few hours. Expected delivery: {delivery_date}.
content_hi: ऑर्डर #{order_id} {courier_name} को सौंप दिया गया। कुछ घंटों में ट्रैकिंग अपडेट होगा। अनुमानित डिलीवरी: {delivery_date}।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} {courier_name} ko de diya. Tracking kuch ghanto mein update hoga. Delivery: {delivery_date}.

title: Local Delivery Tracking
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} is being delivered by our own delivery fleet. Track the agent live here: {tracking_link}. ETA: {delivery_time}.
content_hi: ऑर्डर #{order_id} हमारी अपनी डिलीवरी टीम ले जा रही है। एजेंट को लाइव ट्रैक करें: {tracking_link}। ETA: {delivery_time}।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} humari delivery team le ja rahi hai. Live track: {tracking_link}. ETA: {delivery_time}.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} আমাদের ডেলিভারি টিম নিয়ে যাচ্ছে।

title: Out for Delivery Confirmation
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} is out for delivery and will reach you by {delivery_time}. Please ensure someone is available to receive it.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवरी के लिए निकल गया, {delivery_time} तक पहुँगा। कृपया कोई घर पर उपस्थित रहे।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} delivery ke liye nikal gaya, {delivery_time} tak pahunchega. Koi ghar pe ho.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} ডেলিভারির জন্য বেরিয়েছে, {delivery_time}-এ পৌঁছাবে। কেউ বাড়িতে থাকুন।

title: Delivery Attempt Failed
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we attempted to deliver your order #{order_id} but couldn't reach you. The agent will retry tomorrow between {retry_window}. Please ensure availability or share an alternate address.
content_hi: ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवर करने की कोशिश की लेकिन आपसे संपर्क नहीं हो सका। कल {retry_window} के बीच फिर कोशिश करेंगे। कृपया उपलब्ध रहें।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} deliver nahi ho saka. Kal {retry_window} mein retry karenge. Available raho ya alternate address do.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} ডেলিভারি করতে পারিনি। কাল আবার চেষ্টা করব।

title: Delivery Reschedule
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, please share a convenient time slot for delivery of order #{order_id}. Available slots: {slot_options}. We'll reschedule right away.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} की डिलीवरी के लिए सुविधाजनक समय बताएँ। स्लॉट: {slot_options}। तुरंत रीशेड्यूल करेंगे।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} delivery ke liye convenient time do. Slots: {slot_options}. Reschedule karenge.

title: Delivery Address Verification
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, please confirm your delivery address for order #{order_id}: {address}. If any change is needed, please share the updated address before {cutoff_time}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} के लिए पता कन्फर्म करें: {address}। बदलाव के लिए {cutoff_time} से पहले नया पता दें।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} ka address confirm karein: {address}. Change ke liye {cutoff_time} se pehle naya address dein.

title: Delay Apology - General
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, I'm sorry your order #{order_id} is delayed by {delay_days} days due to {delay_reason}. We're working to dispatch it ASAP. New ETA: {new_eta}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} {delay_reason} के कारण {delay_days} दिन देरी से आ रहा है। जल्दी डिस्पैच कर रहे हैं। नया ETA: {new_eta}।
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, order #{order_id} {delay_days} din late ho raha hai, reason: {delay_reason}. Jaldi dispatch karenge. Naya ETA: {new_eta}.
content_bn: নমস্কার {customer_name}, অর্ডার #{order_id} {delay_days} দিন দেরি হচ্ছে। নতুন ETA: {new_eta}।

title: Delay Apology - Weather
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, severe weather at our dispatch hub has delayed your order #{order_id} by {delay_days} days. We're monitoring closely and will expedite shipping once conditions improve. New ETA: {new_eta}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, डिस्पैच हब पर खराब मौसम के कारण ऑर्डर #{order_id} {delay_days} दिन देरी से आ रहा है। नया ETA: {new_eta}।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} {delay_days} din late, weather reason. Naya ETA: {new_eta}.
content_bn: খারাপ আবহাওয়ার কারণে অর্ডার #{order_id} {delay_days} দিন দেরি হচ্ছে।

title: Delay Apology - Stock
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, one item in your order #{order_id} is unexpectedly out of stock. We can ship the rest now and the remaining item later, or wait — please let us know your preference.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} में एक आइटम अचानक स्टॉक से बाहर है। बाकी अभी और बाकी बाद में भेजें, या रुकें — बताएँ।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} mein ek item out of stock hai. Baaki abhi, baad mein, ya wait — bataiye.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id}-এ একটি আইটেম স্টক নেই। বাকিগুলো এখন, বা অপেক্ষা — জানান।

title: Delay Apology with Compensation
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, I'm sorry for the delay on order #{order_id}. As a goodwill gesture, I've added ₹{compensation_amount} to your wallet, usable on your next order. New ETA: {new_eta}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} में देरी के लिए क्षमा। संकेत स्वरूप ₹{compensation_amount} वॉलेट में जोड़ दिए, अगले ऑर्डर पर उपयोग करें। नया ETA: {new_eta}।
content_hng: Sorry for delay on order #{order_id}. Wallet mein ₹{compensation_amount} add kiya, next order pe use karo. Naya ETA: {new_eta}.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} দেরির জন্য ক্ষমা। ওয়ালেটে ₹{compensation_amount} যোগ করেছি।

title: COD Ready Reminder
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your COD order #{order_id} is out for delivery. Please keep ₹{amount} in exact change ready for the delivery agent arriving between {delivery_window}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, COD ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवरी के लिए निकल गया। एजेंट के लिए ₹{amount} एग्ज़ैक्ट चेंज तैयार रखें, समय: {delivery_window}।
content_hng: COD order #{order_id} out for delivery. ₹{amount} exact change ready rakho, time: {delivery_window}.
content_bn: COD অর্ডার #{order_id} ডেলিভারির জন্য বেরিয়েছে। ₹{amount} প্রস্তুত রাখুন।

title: COD Verification Call
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we're calling to confirm your COD order #{order_id} of ₹{amount}. Please confirm so we can dispatch. If unreachable, the order may be auto-cancelled.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, COD ऑर्डर #{order_id} (₹{amount}) कन्फर्म करने के लिए कॉल कर रहे हैं। कन्फर्म करें ताकि डिस्पैच कर सकें।
content_hng: COD order #{order_id} (₹{amount}) confirm karne ke liye call kar rahe hain. Confirm karo.

title: COD Payment Received
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we've received ₹{amount} for COD order #{order_id} from the delivery agent. Thank you for shopping with {store_name}!
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, COD ऑर्डर #{order_id} के लिए ₹{amount} डिलीवरी एजेंट से मिल गए। {store_name} से खरीदने के लिए धन्यवाद!
content_hng: COD order #{order_id} ke liye ₹{amount} mil gaye. {store_name} se khareedne ke liye dhanyawad!

title: COD Refused by Customer
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, our records show that order #{order_id} was refused at delivery. Could you share what went wrong? We'd love to make this right for you.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवरी पर अस्वीकृत कर दिया गया। क्या बात गलत हुई? हमें बताएँ, ठीक करना चाहेंगे।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} delivery pe refuse ho gaya. Kya galat hua? Batao, theek karna chahte hain.
content_bn: অর্ডার #{order_id} ডেলিভারিতে অস্বীকৃত। কী ভুল হলো জানান।

title: Stock Available
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, good news — {product_name} is in stock! Price: ₹{price}. We have {stock_count} units available. Would you like to place an order now?
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, अच्छी खबर — {product_name} स्टॉक में है! कीमत: ₹{price}। {stock_count} यूनिट उपलब्ध। ऑर्डर करें?
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}, {product_name} stock mein hai! Price: ₹{price}. {stock_count} units available. Order karein?

title: Stock Low Alert
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, {product_name} is running low — only {stock_count} units left! Grab yours before it's gone. Price: ₹{price}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {product_name} लुप्त हो रहा है — सिर्फ़ {stock_count} यूनिट बचे! खत्म होने से पहले ले लें। कीमत: ₹{price}।
content_hng: {product_name} low stock — only {stock_count} units! Le lo before gone. Price: ₹{price}.

title: Stock Replenishment Notice
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, {product_name} is currently out of stock but we expect a fresh batch by {restock_date}. Shall I notify you when it's back, or pre-book it for you?
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {product_name} अभी स्टॉक से बाहर है, लेकिन {restock_date} तक नया बैच आ जाएगा। वापस आने पर सूचित करूँ या प्री-बुक करूँ?
content_hng: {product_name} abhi out of stock hai, par {restock_date} tak fresh batch aayega. Notify karu ya pre-book karu?
content_bn: {product_name} এখন স্টক নেই, {restock_date}-এ নতুন ব্যাচ আসবে।

title: Stock Variant Inquiry
Bulk Stock Quote
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, for bulk orders of {product_name} ({quantity} units), we can offer ₹{bulk_price}/unit. Estimated dispatch: {dispatch_time}. Shall I hold this quote for 48 hours?
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {product_name} के बल्क ऑर्डर ({quantity} यूनिट) के लिए ₹{bulk_price}/यूनिट दे सकते हैं। डिस्पैच: {dispatch_time}। 48 घंटे के लिए रखूँ?
content_hng: {product_name} bulk ({quantity} units) ke liye ₹{bulk_price}/unit. Dispatch: {dispatch_time}. 48 ghante hold karu?

title: Product Specs

title: Store Setup Welcome
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, welcome to {store_name}! Your store dashboard is ready. Let's get you set up: 1) Add your logo, 2) Add products, 3) Configure payment, 4) Launch!
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, {store_name} में स्वागत! डैशबोर्ड तैयार। सेटअप: 1) लोगो, 2) प्रोडक्ट, 3) पेमेंट, 4) लॉन्च!
content_hng: Welcome {vendor_name}! Dashboard ready. Setup: 1) Logo, 2) Products, 3) Payment, 4) Launch!

title: Store Setup Help
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, need help setting up your store? I'd recommend starting with our quick setup guide: {guide_link}. Or I can walk you through it — just let me know a convenient time.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, स्टोर सेटअप में मदद चाहिए? क्विक सेटअप गाइड: {guide_link}। या मैं चलते-चलते समझा सकता हूँ, समय बताएँ।
content_hng: Setup help chahiye? Quick guide: {guide_link}. Ya main samjha sakta hoon.

title: First Product Help
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, ready to add your first product? Just go to Products → Add New, upload photos, set price, and you're live! Watch this 2-min video: {video_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, पहला प्रोडक्ट जोड़ने के लिए तैयार? Products → Add New में जाएँ, फोटो अपलोड करें, कीमत लगाएँ, लाइव! वीडियो: {video_link}
content_hng: Pehla product add karo: Products → Add New. Photos, price, live! Video: {video_link}
content_bn: প্রথম প্রোডাক্ট যোগ করুন: Products → Add New।

title: Payment Setup Help
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, to accept online payments, link your bank account in Settings → Payment. We support UPI, cards, wallets, and COD. Activation takes 24 hours.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, ऑनलाइन पेमेंट के लिए Settings → Payment में बैंक अकाउंट जोड़ें। UPI, कार्ड, वॉलेट, COD सपोर्ट। 24 घंटे में एक्टिव।
content_hng: Online payment ke liye Settings → Payment mein bank add karo. UPI, cards, COD. 24 ghante mein active.
content_bn: অনলাইন পেমেন্টের জন্য Settings → Payment-এ ব্যাংক যোগ করুন।

title: Plugin Recommendation
Plugin Installation
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, to install {plugin_name} plugin, go to Settings → Plugins → {plugin_name} → Install. Setup takes 2 minutes. Need help? Watch: {video_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, {plugin_name} प्लगइन के लिए Settings → Plugins → {plugin_name} → Install। 2 मिनट में। वीडियो: {video_link}
content_hng: {plugin_name} install: Settings → Plugins → {plugin_name} → Install. 2 min. Video: {video_link}

title: Plugin Conflict
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, I see a conflict between {plugin_a} and {plugin_b}. Try disabling {plugin_b} temporarily and check if the issue resolves. If not, share screenshots.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, {plugin_a} और {plugin_b} में टकराव। {plugin_b} अस्थायी रूप से बंद कर जाँचें। नहीं तो स्क्रीनशॉट भेजें।
content_hng: {plugin_a} aur {plugin_b} mein conflict. {plugin_b} disable karke check karo.

title: Domain Connect Help
content_bn: {domain_name} কনেক্ট করতে DNS রেকর্ড যোগ করুন।

title: Domain SSL Active
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, SSL certificate is now active for your domain {domain_name}. Your store is accessible at https://{domain_name}. Padlock icon confirms security.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, डोमेन {domain_name} के लिए SSL एक्टिव। स्टोर https://{domain_name} पर। पैडलॉक सुरक्षा की पुष्टि करता है।
content_hng: SSL active for {domain_name}. Store at https://{domain_name}.

title: Domain Propagation
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, your domain {domain_name} is propagating. This usually takes 24-48 hours. We'll notify you when it's fully live.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, डोमेन {domain_name} प्रोपेगेट हो रहा। 24-48 घंटे लगते हैं। पूरी तरह लाइव होने पर सूचित करेंगे।
content_hng: Domain {domain_name} propagate ho raha. 24-48 ghante. Live hone pe notify karenge.

title: Abandoned Cart Reminder
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we noticed you left some items in your cart at {store_name}. Your selection is saved — complete your order now: {cart_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, आपने {store_name} में कुछ आइटम कार्ट में छोड़े। सेलेक्शन सेव है — ऑर्डर पूरा करें: {cart_link}
content_hng: Cart mein items chhode the. Save hai — order complete karo: {cart_link}
content_bn: কার্টে কিছু আইটেম রেখেছেন। অর্ডার সম্পূর্ণ করুন: {cart_link}

title: Abandoned Cart with Discount
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your cart at {store_name} is waiting! Here's {discount}% off to help you complete the order. Code: {code} (valid {validity}). Cart: {cart_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} का कार्ट इंतज़ार कर रहा! ऑर्डर पूरा करने के लिए {discount}% छूट। कोड: {code} ({validity} तक)। कार्ट: {cart_link}
content_hng: Cart wait kar raha! {discount}% off. Code: {code} ({validity} tak). Cart: {cart_link}

content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, यह आख़िरी रिमाइंडर है — {store_name} का कार्ट {hours} घंटों में एक्सपायर। स्टॉक ख़त्म हो सकता। अभी: {cart_link}
content_hng: Last reminder — cart {hours} ghanto mein expire. Stock khatam ho sakta. Abhi: {cart_link}
content_bn: শেষ রিমাইন্ডার — কার্ট {hours} ঘণ্টায় মেয়াদ শেষ।

title: Abandoned Cart - Stock Risk
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, heads up — {product_name} in your cart is low in stock ({stock_count} left). Complete your order soon before it's gone: {cart_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, कार्ट में {product_name} स्टॉक कम है ({stock_count} बचे)। जल्दी ऑर्डर पूरा करें: {cart_link}
content_hng: Cart mein {product_name} low stock ({stock_count} left). Jaldi order complete karo: {cart_link}

title: Wishlist Price Drop
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, good news! {product_name} in your wishlist just dropped by {discount}%. New price: ₹{new_price}. Grab it now: {product_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, विशलिस्ट में {product_name} {discount}% सस्ता हुआ! नया मूल्य: ₹{new_price}। अभी लें: {product_link}
content_hng: Wishlist {product_name} {discount}% sasta! Naya price: ₹{new_price}. Abhi lo: {product_link}

title: Wishlist Back in Stock
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, {product_name} in your wishlist is back in stock! Order before it sells out again: {product_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, विशलिस्ट में {product_name} वापस स्टॉक में! ख़त्म होने से पहले ऑर्डर करें: {product_link}
content_hng: Wishlist {product_name} wapas stock mein! Order before gone: {product_link}

title: Wishlist Reminder
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, you have {count} items in your wishlist. Want to revisit and see if any are on offer? View wishlist: {wishlist_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, विशलिस्ट में {count} आइटम। ऑफर देखें? विशलिस्ट: {wishlist_link}
content_hng: Wishlist mein {count} items hain. Offer dekho? {wishlist_link}

title: Cart Free Shipping Incentive
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, complete your cart now and get free shipping on your order! Just add code FREESHIP at checkout. Cart: {cart_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, कार्ट अभी पूरा करें, फ्री शिपिंग! कोड FREESHIP लगाएँ। कार्ट: {cart_link}
content_hng: Cart abhi complete karo, free shipping! Code FREESHIP. Cart: {cart_link}
content_bn: কার্ট সম্পূর্ণ করুন, ফ্রি শিপিং! FREESHIP কোড।

title: Cart Scratch Card Reward
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, complete your order now and unlock a surprise scratch card — win up to ₹{max_reward} in wallet rewards! Cart: {cart_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर पूरा करें और स्क्रैच कार्ड खोलें — ₹{max_reward} तक वॉलेट रिवॉर्ड! कार्ट: {cart_link}
content_hng: Order complete karo aur scratch card kholo — ₹{max_reward} tak reward! Cart: {cart_link}
content_bn: অর্ডার সম্পূর্ণ করে স্ক্র্যাচ কার্ড খুলুন — ₹{max_reward} পর্যন্ত!

title: Wishlist to Cart Conversion
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your wishlist has been waiting! Move items to cart with one tap and checkout in seconds: {wishlist_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, विशलिस्ट इंतज़ार कर रही! एक टैप में कार्ट में ले जाएँ: {wishlist_link}
content_hng: Wishlist intezaar kar rahi! One tap mein cart mein le jao: {wishlist_link}
content_bn: উইশলিস্ট অপেক্ষা করছে! এক ট্যাপে কার্টে।

title: Wishlist Expiring
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, some items in your wishlist are running low in stock. Don't miss out — move them to cart before they're gone: {wishlist_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, विशलिस्ट के कुछ आइटम स्टॉक कम हैं। मत चूकें — कार्ट में ले जाएँ: {wishlist_link}
content_hng: Wishlist ke kuch items low stock. Cart mein le jao: {wishlist_link}

content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} was delivered recently. Would you mind leaving a quick review? It takes 30 seconds and helps other shoppers: {review_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} हाल ही में डिलीवर हुआ। 30 सेकंड का रिव्यू देंगे? दूसरों को मदद मिलेगी: {review_link}
content_hng: Order #{order_id} deliver hua. 30 sec ka review do? {review_link}

title: Review with Photo
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, loved your recent purchase from {store_name}? Share a photo with your review and get {reward} in your wallet! Review: {review_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} से खरीद पसंद आई? फोटो के साथ रिव्यू शेयर करें, वॉलेट में {reward}! रिव्यू: {review_link}

content_bn: ছবি সহ রিভিউ শেয়ার করুন, ওয়ালেটে {reward}!

content_en: Hi {customer_name}, share your experience with {product_name} and get {discount}% off your next order! Review here: {review_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {product_name} का अनुभव शेयर करें, अगले ऑर्डर पर {discount}% छूट! रिव्यू: {review_link}
content_hng: Experience share karo, next order pe {discount}% off! {review_link}

content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, बढ़िया 5-स्टार रिव्यू के लिए धन्यवाद! {product_name} पसंद आने की खुशी। Instagram @{social_handle} पर टैग करें!
content_hng: 5-star review ke liye dhanyawad! {product_name} pasand aane ki khushi. Instagram @{social_handle} tag karo!

content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, अनुभव खराब रहा, क्षमा। आपकी फीडबैक गंभीरता से लेते हैं। विवरण {support_email} पर या DM में भेजें — ठीक करना चाहूँगा।
content_hng: Sorry experience kharab raha. Details {support_email} ya DM mein bhejo.

title: Reply to Neutral Review
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for taking time to review {product_name}. We're glad it mostly worked for you. Is there anything we can do to make it a 5-star experience next time?
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {product_name} रिव्यू के लिए धन्यवाद। ज़्यादातर ठीक रहा। 5-स्टार अनुभव के लिए कुछ कर सकें?
content_hng: Review ke liye dhanyawad. 5-star experience ke liye kuch kar saken?

content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we'd love your input on {product_name}! What did you love? What could be better? Your feedback shapes future versions: {feedback_link}

content_hng: {product_name} pe aapki ray chahiye! Feedback link: {feedback_link}

title: Feature Suggestion

content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, फ़ीचर सुझाव के लिए धन्यवाद! प्रोडक्ट टीम के लिए लॉग कर दिया। समय देना नहीं दे सकते, लेकिन हर सुझाव हफ़्ते में जाँचा जाता।
content_hng: Feature suggestion ke liye dhanyawad! Product team ne log kiya. Weekly review hota hai.

content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} का रिटर्न शुरू। पिकअप {pickup_date} को। आइटम मिलने के {refund_days} दिनों में रिफंड।
content_hng: Return start. Pickup {pickup_date} ko. Item milne ke {refund_days} mein refund.

title: Return Pickup Scheduled
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, return pickup for order #{order_id} is confirmed for {pickup_date} between {pickup_window}. Please keep the item packed with original tags.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} का रिटर्न पिकअप {pickup_date} को {pickup_window} के बीच। आइटम मूल टैग के साथ पैक रखें।
content_hng: Return pickup {pickup_date} ko {pickup_window} ke beech. Original tags ke saath pack rakho.

title: Return Guidelines
content_en:
Hi {customer_name}, to process your return smoothly:
• Item must be unused with original tags
• Pack in original packaging if possible
• Keep invoice handy
• Handover to pickup agent
content_hi:
नमस्ते {customer_name}, सुचारू रिटर्न के लिए:
• आइटम अप्रयुक्त, मूल टैग
• मूल पैकेजिंग में पैक
• इनवॉइस पास रखें
• एजेंट को सौंपें
content_hng:
Smooth return ke liye:
• Unused, original tags
• Original packaging
• Invoice ready
• Agent ko handover

title: Return Picked Up
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your return for order #{order_id} has been picked up successfully. It's on the way to our warehouse — we'll inspect and process your refund within {refund_days} of receipt.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} का रिटर्न पिकअप हो गया। वेयरहाउस के रास्ते — जाँच के बाद {refund_days} दिनों में रिफंड।
content_hng: Return pickup ho gaya. Warehouse on the way — inspect ke {refund_days} din mein refund.

title: Return Approved
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your return for order #{order_id} has been approved after inspection. Refund of ₹{amount} will be processed within {refund_days} business days.

content_hng: Return approved. ₹{amount} refund {refund_days} din mein.

title: Return Rejected
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, unfortunately your return for order #{order_id} couldn't be approved because {rejection_reason}. Please check our return policy or contact us with questions.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} का रिटर्न मंज़ूर नहीं, कारण: {rejection_reason}। रिटर्न पॉलिसी देखें या संपर्क करें।
content_hng: Return reject, reason: {rejection_reason}. Policy dekho ya contact karo.

title: Damaged Product Replacement

content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we've processed a full refund of ₹{amount} for the damaged item in order #{order_id}. It will reflect in your source account within {refund_days} business days.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} के क्षतिग्रस्त आइटम का पूरा ₹{amount} रिफंड किया। {refund_days} दिनों में खाते में।
content_hng: Full ₹{amount} refund for damaged item. {refund_days} din mein account.

content_en: Hi {customer_name}, I'm sorry you received the wrong item in order #{order_id}. Please share a photo of what you received at {support_link}. We'll arrange the correct item ASAP.

content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} का सही आइटम रास्ते में। ट्रैकिंग: {tracking_link}। ग़लत आइटम पिकअप के लिए तैयार रखें।
content_hng: Sahi item on the way. Tracking: {tracking_link}. Wrong item pickup ke liye ready rakho.
content_bn: সঠিক আইটেম পাঠাচ্ছি। ভুল আইटেম পিকআপে দিন।

title: Wrong Item Return Pickup
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, pickup for the wrong item from order #{order_id} is scheduled for {pickup_date} between {pickup_window}. Please keep it packed and ready.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} के ग़लत आइटम का पिकअप {pickup_date} को {pickup_window}। पैक और तैयार रखें।
content_hng: Wrong item pickup {pickup_date} ko {pickup_window}. Pack aur ready rakho.

title: WhatsApp Welcome
content_en: Hi {customer_name}! 👋 Thanks for reaching out to {store_name} on WhatsApp. I'm here to help with orders, products, returns, and anything else. How can I assist today?
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}! 👋 {store_name} WhatsApp पर संपर्क के लिए धन्यवाद। ऑर्डर, प्रोडक्ट, रिटर्न में मदद करूँगा। बताइए?
content_hng: Hi {customer_name}! 👋 {store_name} WhatsApp pe help karunga. Batao?

title: WhatsApp Auto-Reply
content_en: Hi! Thanks for messaging {store_name}. We typically reply within {response_time}. For urgent help, call {phone_number}. Meanwhile, share your order ID for faster service.
content_hi: नमस्ते! {store_name} को संदेश के लिए धन्यवाद। आमतौर पर {response_time} में जवाब। ज़रूरी हो तो कॉल: {phone_number}। ऑर्डर ID दें, तेज़ सेवा।
content_hng: Hi! {store_name} ko message ke liye dhanyawad. {response_time} mein reply. Urgent: {phone_number}. Order ID do.

title: WhatsApp Off-Hours
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, thanks for your message! Our team is offline right now. We'll respond when we're back at {return_time}. For urgent order queries, please use the app.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, संदेश के लिए धन्यवाद! टीम अभी ऑफलाइन। वापसी {return_time} पर जवाब देंगे। ज़रूरी ऑर्डर सवाल के लिए ऐप इस्तेमाल करें।
content_hng: Message ke liye dhanyawad! Team offline. {return_time} pe reply. Urgent ke liye app.

title: WhatsApp Order Confirmation
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} (₹{amount}) is confirmed! We'll keep you updated on WhatsApp. Track: {tracking_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} (₹{amount}) कन्फर्म! WhatsApp पर अपडेट देंगे। ट्रैक: {tracking_link}
content_hng: Order #{order_id} (₹{amount}) confirm! WhatsApp pe update. Track: {tracking_link}

title: WhatsApp Delivery Alert
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} is out for delivery! Agent will arrive by {delivery_time}. Keep ₹{amount} ready if COD. Tracking: {tracking_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवरी के लिए! एजेंट {delivery_time} तक। COD हो तो ₹{amount} तैयार। ट्रैक: {tracking_link}
content_hng: Order #{order_id} delivery! Agent {delivery_time} tak. COD: ₹{amount}. Track: {tracking_link}

title: WhatsApp Delivered
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your order #{order_id} has been delivered! ✅ Hope you love it. Any issues, just message here. Would you mind sharing a quick review? {review_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} डिलीवर हो गया! ✅ पसंद आए तो बताएँ। समस्या हो तो यहीं संदेश दें। रिव्यू? {review_link}
content_hng: Order #{order_id} deliver hua! ✅ Issue ho toh message. Review? {review_link}

title: WhatsApp Support Handover
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, I've shared your query with our support team. They'll revert on this chat within {response_time}. Your reference: #{ticket_id}. Anything else in the meantime?
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, आपका सवाल सपोर्ट टीम को दिया। इसी चैट पर {response_time} में जवाब। रेफरेंस: #{ticket_id}। और कुछ?
content_hng: Query support team ko diya. Isi chat pe {response_time} mein reply. Ref: #{ticket_id}.

title: WhatsApp Quick Reply
content_en:
Hi {customer_name}, thanks for your message! Here's a quick answer to common questions:
• Order status: Check app or share order ID
• Returns: Within 7 days, unused
• Payment: UPI, cards, COD accepted
Anything specific I can help with?
content_hi:
नमस्ते {customer_name}, संदेश के लिए धन्यवाद! आम सवालों के जवाब:
• ऑर्डर: ऐप या ID दें
• रिटर्न: 7 दिन, अप्रयुक्त
• पेमेंट: UPI, कार्ड, COD
विशेष मदद चाहिए?
content_hng:
Common answers:
• Order: App ya ID do
• Returns: 7 din, unused
• Payment: UPI, cards, COD
Specific help?
content_bn:
সাধারণ প্রশ্ন:
• অর্ডার: অ্যাপ বা ID
• রিটার্ন: ৭ দিন
• পেমেন্ট: UPI, কার্ড, COD

title: WhatsApp Order ID Request
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, to help you faster, please share your order ID (starts with #). You'll find it in your order confirmation SMS or email. Once I have it, I can pull up your details right away.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, तेज़ मदद के लिए ऑर्डर ID (# से शुरू) दें। SMS या ईमेल में मिलेगा। मिलते ही विवरण देख लूँगा।
content_hng: Order ID (# se shuru) do. SMS ya email mein milega.
content_bn: অর্ডার ID (# দিয়ে শুরু) দিন। SMS/ইমেলে আছে।

title: Vendor Onboarding Welcome
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, welcome to {store_name} as a vendor partner! Your onboarding is complete. Add your first product and start selling. Our team is here if you need help.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, {store_name} वेंडर पार्टनर के रूप में स्वागत! ऑनबोर्डिंग पूरी। पहला प्रोडक्ट जोड़कर बिक्री शुरू करें। मदद चाहिए तो बताएँ।
content_hng: Vendor partner ke roop mein swagat! Onboarding done. Pehla product add karke selling start karo.
content_bn: ভেন্ডর পার্টনার হিসেবে স্বাগত! অনবোর্ডিং সম্পূর্ণ।

title: Vendor KYC Required
content_en:
Hi {vendor_name}, to activate payouts, please complete KYC:
• GST certificate
• Bank account details
• PAN card
Upload at: {kyc_link}. Activation within 48 hours of submission.
content_hi:
नमस्ते {vendor_name}, पेआउट एक्टिवेट करने के लिए KYC:
• GST प्रमाणपत्र
• बैंक खाता
• PAN कार्ड
अपलोड: {kyc_link}। 48 घंटों में एक्टिव।
content_hng: Payout activate ke liye KYC: GST, bank, PAN. Upload: {kyc_link}. 48 ghante mein active.
content_bn: পেআউটের জন্য KYC: GST, ব্যাংক, PAN। আপলোড: {kyc_link}।

title: Vendor KYC Approved
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, your KYC is approved! ✅ Payouts are now active. First payout for your sales will be processed on {payout_date}. Happy selling!
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, KYC मंज़ूर! ✅ पेआउट एक्टिव। पहला पेआउट {payout_date} को। बिक्री शुभकामना!
content_hng: KYC approved! ✅ Payouts active. First payout {payout_date} ko.

title: New Branch Setup
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, to add a new branch, go to Settings → Branches → Add New. Enter branch name, address, and inventory. Each branch manages its own orders and stock separately.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, नई ब्रांच के लिए Settings → Branches → Add New। नाम, पता, इन्वेंटरी डालें। हर ब्रांच अपने ऑर्डर और स्टॉक स्वतंत्र रूप से संभालती।
content_hng: New branch: Settings → Branches → Add New. Name, address, inventory. Har branch alag.
content_bn: নতুন ব্রাঞ্চ: Settings → Branches → Add New।

title: Branch Order Rerouted
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, due to stock availability, your order #{order_id} is being fulfilled by our {branch_name} branch instead. Delivery timeline remains the same. Tracking: {tracking_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, स्टॉक के कारण ऑर्डर #{order_id} हमारी {branch_name} ब्रांच से जा रहा। डिलीवरी समय वही। ट्रैक: {tracking_link}
content_hng: Order #{order_id} {branch_name} branch se. Delivery same. Track: {tracking_link}

title: Branch Inventory Sync
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, your branch {branch_name} inventory is now synced with the main dashboard. Stock updates will reflect in real time across all branches.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, ब्रांच {branch_name} की इन्वेंटरी मुख्य डैशबोर्ड से सिंक हो गई। स्टॉक अपडेट रियल-टाइम में सभी ब्रांच में दिखेंगे।
content_hng: Branch {branch_name} inventory synced. Real-time stock updates.

title: Payout Processed
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, your payout of ₹{amount} for sales between {period_start} and {period_end} has been processed to your bank account {bank_last_4}. Expected credit: {credit_date}.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, {period_start}–{period_end} की बिक्री का ₹{amount} पेआउट बैंक {bank_last_4} में प्रोसेस। क्रेडिट: {credit_date}।
content_hng: Payout ₹{amount} process hua bank {bank_last_4} mein. Credit: {credit_date}.

title: Payout Delayed
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, your payout of ₹{amount} is delayed due to {delay_reason}. New expected date: {new_date}. We apologize for the inconvenience.
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, ₹{amount} पेआउट {delay_reason} के कारण देरी से। नया दिन: {new_date}। असुविधा के लिए क्षमा।
content_hng: Payout ₹{amount} delay, reason: {delay_reason}. New date: {new_date}.

title: Payout Statement
content_en: Hi {vendor_name}, your payout statement for {month} is ready. Total sales: ₹{total_sales}. Commission: ₹{commission}. Net payout: ₹{net_payout}. Download: {statement_link}
content_hi: नमस्ते {vendor_name}, {month} का पेआउट स्टेटमेंट तैयार। कुल बिक्री: ₹{total_sales}। कमीशन: ₹{commission}। नेट पेआउट: ₹{net_payout}। डाउनलोड: {statement_link}
content_hng: {month} payout statement ready. Sales ₹{total_sales}, commission ₹{commission}, net ₹{net_payout}.

title: Order Modification Request
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, I can help modify order #{order_id}. Please share what you'd like to change (address, items, quantity). Note: modifications are only possible before dispatch.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} में बदलाव मदद करूँगा। बताएँ क्या बदलना है (पता, आइटम, क्वांटिटी)। डिस्पैच से पहले ही संभव।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} mein change madad karunga. Kya badalna hai batao. Dispatch se pehle hi possible.

title: Order Cancellation Confirmation
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, order #{order_id} has been successfully cancelled. Refund of ₹{amount} (if prepaid) will be processed within {refund_days} business days to your original payment method.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} कैंसिल हो गया। रिफंड ₹{amount} (प्रीपेड हो तो) {refund_days} दिनों में।
content_hng: Order #{order_id} cancel ho gaya. Refund ₹{amount} {refund_days} din mein.

title: Delivery Agent Contact
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, your delivery agent for order #{order_id} is {agent_name}. Phone: {agent_phone}. You can call them directly if you need to coordinate the delivery.
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} का डिलीवरी एजेंट {agent_name}। फोन: {agent_phone}। सीधे संपर्क कर सकते हैं।
content_hng: Delivery agent {agent_name}. Phone: {agent_phone}. Directly call kar sakte ho.

title: Payment Confirmation
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we've received ₹{amount} for order #{order_id} via {payment_method}. Transaction ID: {txn_id}. Thank you for your payment!
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, ऑर्डर #{order_id} के लिए ₹{amount} प्राप्त ({payment_method})। ट्रांज़ैक्शन ID: {txn_id}। धन्यवाद!
content_hng: ₹{amount} mil gaya order #{order_id} ke liye ({payment_method}). Txn ID: {txn_id}.

title: Customer Appreciation
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we just wanted to take a moment to thank you for being a loyal {store_name} customer. Customers like you make our work meaningful. Here's a small token of gratitude: {appreciation_offer}
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {store_name} के वफ़ादार ग्राहक होने के लिए धन्यवाद। आप जैसे ग्राहक हमें प्रेरित करते हैं। छोटा तोहफ़ा: {appreciation_offer}
content_hng: Loyal customer hone ke liye dhanyawad. Aap jaise customer inspire karte hain. Tohfa: {appreciation_offer}
content_bn: বিশ্বস্ত গ্রাহক হওয়ার জন্য ধন্যবাদ। উপহার: {appreciation_offer}

title: Service Outage Notice
content_en: Hi {customer_name}, we're experiencing a temporary service disruption affecting {affected_service}. Our team is working on it and we expect to be back by {restore_time}. Sorry for the inconvenience!
content_hi: नमस्ते {customer_name}, {affected_service} में अस्थायी बाधा। टीम काम कर रही, {restore_time} तक ठीक। असुविधा के लिए क्षमा!
content_hng: {affected_service} mein temporary issue. Team kaam kar rahi, {restore_time} tak theek.
